comparison.objective: Pull the top end of a layered hose from its bed and lay the end on a hydrant pad; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Selecting the accessible hose end and managing a long deformable object versus rigid coaxial alignment, hammer striking, and small-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Correct hose end deployed onto the pad and released versus four contact-loaded fractures, all tangs contained, retained inserts, and no damage. Pad tolerance and hose-layer constraints are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Deformable hose deployment tests a different mechanism and outcome from precision insert finishing.
